types.description: Wrong, missing or extra particle (は, が, を, に, で, ...).
Conjunctions, prefixes, suffixes and connecting expressions.
Verb conjugation, auxiliary forms and compound verb patterns.
Giving and receiving verbs and patterns (あげる, くれる, もらう, ...).
Politeness level, honorific and humble language.
Conditional forms (たら, ば, と, なら).
Obligation, permission and prohibition patterns.
Desire, intention, plans and volitional patterns.
Conjecture, judgment, hearsay and appearance (らしい, そうだ, ようだ, ...).
Comparison, degree and limitation (より, ほど, だけ, しか, ...).
Time, situation and aspect (ている, てから, ところ, ...).
Reason, cause and concession (から, ので, のに, けれど, ...).
Kanji, kana and spelling mistakes.
Conjugation of i-adjectives and na-adjectives.
Word or phrase order within the sentence.
Counters and number expressions.
Transitive versus intransitive verb choice.
Wrong or unnatural word choice.
Style, register and discourse flow.
Punctuation and symbols.
Any error that fits no other type.
